notes:
POC focus: mid-market B2B chat agent that uses streaming + tool-calls (crm-search, billing-lookup, outbound-email tool). Key constraints: must hit p95 response time targets for interactive assistant and not degrade under bursty morning traffic.

Shorthand notes from SE Nora:
- streaming first-byte target: <=150ms (NA), <=200ms (EU ideally)
- interactive p95 (turn completion): <350ms for simple queries, <700ms when invoking external tool
- tool-calls: synchronous function calls to our webhook router; durable retry/timeout semantics needed (customer wants 2s tail budget)
- routing: want smart routing by region + fallback to compatible model/region if capacity constrained (explicit ask: automatic fallback to smaller quantized variant with graceful degradation)

Quote from CTO Janice Chen: "We will accept lower-quality fallbacks but cannot have whole clusters go down — routing/fallback policy is a must."

Operational asks: token-level cost breakdown, ability to pin model version per route, canary rollout for model upgrades, and long-term plan to move to Dedicated if 99th percentile throughput rises.
